turns.text: What is the difference between ABHA Number and ABHA Address?

must_contain: An ABHA number is fourteen digits, issued only after a successful KYC check
An ABHA address is the name a person goes by on ABDM, written like an email address, such as ajeet123@abdm on production or something@sbx on the sandbox
A person logs in to their PHR app with the address and shares it at a facility so the facility can find them, and every record linked to the person is linked against it
notes: NHA PHR review, 30 September 2026, case 5: 'ABHA number is clear, but ABHA Address definition is not clear'. Verdict group: language and register. The rejected answer called the address 'a readable handle used to route consent requests' and ended on a common mistake. Distinct from confusable-hiecm-m1-abha-number-vs-address-01, which asks which one to store as the patient id. The router gives this the define shape today because 'What is' is matched before 'difference'.
